description:
Protect-your-assets check for one portfolio, from your own bars: measurable conditions on the
    losing side of the user's positions, with the evidence. Read the playbook first: MCP resource
    thestrat://playbooks/protect-portfolio (or the prompt protect_portfolio).

    Returns (1) the market condition: "Algorithmic buying identified in VIX while algorithmic selling in
    4 major indexes" (VIX symbol over its M W D 60 opens, SPY QQQ IWM DIA each under all 4), confirmed or
    not at a 60-minute close, plus the VIX futures curve state if given; (2) per position, the opens on
    the holder's losing side (long: under the open = buyers on that timeframe are losing; short: over the
    open = sellers are losing), reversals in force against the position (buy/sell list rule) and setups
    against it (trigger not taken), with trigger, target and level of reclaim; (3) concentration: the %
    of the user's basket (and of each ETF basket) whose current bar took the prior bar's low or high,
    labelled at 80%+. Each part has `text` to quote and source URLs. Conditions only: not a buy or sell
    signal. Quote `footer` at the end.

as_of.description: Optional ISO time. Use only bars that start at or before this time (replay a past bar).
as_of.title: As Of

bars_by_timeframe.description: Bars per timeframe, then per symbol: {"M": {"NVDA": [...], "VIXY": [...], "SPY": [...]}, "W": {...}, "D": {...}, "60": {...}}. Each position on the user's timeframes (investor Y; position trader Q M; swing or day trader W D 60). VIX or a VIX ETN (VIXY, VXX, UVXY) and SPY QQQ IWM DIA on M W D 60 for the market condition. The last bar of each timeframe must be the current bar (its open is the open). 60 symbols and 500 bars per symbol per timeframe; 10 to 50 bars are enough.
bars_by_timeframe.title: Bars By Timeframe

etf_baskets.description: Optional, up to 3: the holdings of an ETF the user owns, {"WGMI": {"IREN": [...], ...}}, on etf_timeframe. For the concentration check.
etf_baskets.title: Etf Baskets

etf_timeframe.description: Timeframe of the etf_baskets bars: D (default) or W.
etf_timeframe.title: Etf Timeframe

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Decides if the last bar is still open. Default: the server clock.
now.title: Now

position_timeframes.description: The user's timeframes for the positions: ["Y"] investor, ["Q", "M"] position trader, ["W", "D", "60"] swing or day trader. Positions are checked only on these. Ask the user.
position_timeframes.title: Position Timeframes

positions.description: The user's positions: {"NVDA": "long", "TSLA": "short"} or [{"symbol": "NVDA", "side": "long"}]. Up to 25. Sizes are not needed.
positions.title: Positions

vix_curve.description: Optional VIX futures prices {"front": 18.2, "second": 19.0}. Front over second = backwardation. Leave out if you have no curve data (the reply then says: no data).
vix_curve.title: Vix Curve

name: portfolio_check
